output: Thanks for being open about the management pack. Spreadsheets stay part of most finance workflows, and it makes sense that your team rebuilds the pack in Excel when a system hasn't matched the layout you need. Our spreadsheet add-in gives your team two-way refresh and write-back, so the numbers in your workbook can stay current without a manual rebuild, and our formatted report templates cover the common board and management layouts. Highly custom layouts may still be finished in a spreadsheet, and we'll be clear about that. For example, [PROOF] I'd like to offer a short working session where we rebuild one of your current spreadsheet reports together, so you can see where the add-in fits and where it doesn't.
